project.title: Reese's Sodium Options
project.body:
Reese's Sodium Options replaces Sodium's options screen with an alternate layout and styling focused on a compact, navigable configuration experience.

Modern Sodium already provides a full configuration screen and public options API. RSO is mainly an alternative frontend for users who prefer its tab layout, grouped presentation, styling, and extra quality-of-life controls.

# Features

- Alternative Sodium options screen layout and styling.
- Search bar for quickly finding options.
- Scrollable vertical tab list and option pages.
- Collapsible mod tab groups with configurable behavior.
- Collapsible option groups within pages.
- Customizable tab headers, including icons and version labels.
- Configurable tooltip delay and optional option ID display.
- Focused option tooltips for keyboard/controller navigation.
- Optional color themes for option pages and controls.
- Per-option reset-to-default overlay.
- Per-option undo overlay for modified options.
- `SHIFT` + scroll slider adjustments.
- Optional reverse cycling controls.
- Improved keyboard navigation.
- UI narration support.
- Optional Controlify support for controller navigation and button guides.
- Option to disable RSO and return to Sodium's default options screen.

# Screenshots

![image2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Bh37bMuy/images/ef92f9dbadd953c9acfbc0a5246921a8226dac1c.png)

![image](https://i.imgur.com/KBsXRBI.png)

# Requirements

- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)

# Optional Integrations

- [Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify) for controller navigation support.

# Notes

RSO is a client-side UI replacement for Sodium's options screen. It is not required for Sodium configuration, and it is intended for users who prefer RSO's layout, styling, and quality-of-life behavior.

Sodium Options API is no longer supported on versions where Sodium already provides the relevant options API directly.

#### Please do not ask CaffeineMC for support with this mod. Reese's Sodium Options has no affiliation with CaffeineMC.

# Support the Project

If you want to support the time that goes into maintaining Reese's Sodium Options and my other Minecraft mods, you can do so through Ko-fi.

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://i.imgur.com/FSNi7zk.png)](https://ko-fi.com/flashyreese)

versions.name: [Fabric] Reese's Sodium Options 2.2.3 - Minecraft 26.2
versions.changelog:
### Search improvements

- Improved search-result highlighting with clearer match markers, selection borders, and tooltips for the active result.
- Added a configurable search-result limit.
- Added `Shift+Enter` to cycle backward through search results; `Enter` continues cycling forward.
- Added keypad Enter support.
- Fixed search cycling sometimes selecting a result without scrolling it into view, particularly on long pages.

### Option controls

- Added an “Always Show Action Buttons” setting.
- Reset and undo buttons can remain visible while unavailable actions are shown as disabled.

### Controller support

- Fixed Controlify tab and header cycling position.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/reeses-sodium-options/compare/mc26.2-2.2.2...mc26.2-2.2.3

versions.name: [Fabric] Reese's Sodium Options 2.2.0 - Minecraft 26.2
versions.changelog:
### Changes

This release improves Reese's Sodium Options with a redesigned options screen, better keyboard and controller navigation, Controlify support, screen narration, and several quality-of-life fixes.

- Added full keyboard navigation support for moving through tabs, options, sliders, buttons, and search.
- Added Controlify support, including controller navigation, tab switching, option interaction, search handling, and contextual button guides.
- Added screen narration support for option rows, controls, tabs, buttons, labels, scrollbars, and search.
- Added reset-to-default and undo overlays for options.
- Added tooltips for focused options when navigating with keyboard or controller.
- Added more RSO customization options, including tab header behavior, collapsible groups, tooltip delay, option IDs in tooltips, color themes, reverse cycling controls, shift-scroll slider adjustment, and overlay controls.
- Reworked the options screen UI internals for better focus handling, scrolling, tabs, search, option rows, and action buttons.
- Improved focus borders so they appear for keyboard/controller navigation without lingering after mouse input.
- Fixed slider undo overlay behavior while dragging slider values.
- Fixed slider edit mode so Back/Escape exits editing instead of closing the screen.
- Fixed tab header text centering.
- Fixed the Reese's Sodium Options tab ordering on NeoForge so it appears last as intended.
- Added the Reese's Sodium Options icon to Sodium's config screen metadata.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FlashyReese/reeses-sodium-options/compare/mc26.2-2.1.0...mc26.2-2.2.0
